title: Landscape printing
body: There is no option to print or export an pdf in landscape. This is mind boggling. From time to time I install sheets again just to check if it’s been implemented but no and I’ve  been doing this for four years now. Google Docs has it… so does all Microsoft apps but it’s a no go for Sheets. This one thing that I can’t print/export in landscape is the only thing that prevents me from using iPad as an only computing device. I can make the spreadsheet on my iPad but eventually I have to go to my pc to make the landscape print. Unbelievable.
